title: 友邦首席配置官：市场广度扩大，集中度风险缓解
speaker: Mark Conan

segments.en: in the last few stages of the cycle that's been really driven by a small number of companies that are tech oriented AI oriented
segments.zh: 在周期后期阶段，主要由少数科技和AI导向的公司驱动

segments.en: but we are starting to see a broadening out and interestingly if you look at the performance of the Russell 2000 value is actually ahead of the Nasdaq and the S&P year-to-date
segments.zh: 但我们开始看到市场拓宽，有趣的是，罗素2000价值股今年迄今表现领先纳斯达克和标普

segments.en: so these things are creeping up on investors so a lot of concern about valuation but we are seeing a broadening out of the market and that's a very positive sign
segments.zh: 这些变化悄悄来临，尽管估值担忧存在，但市场拓宽是非常积极的信号

segments.en: because that market concentration for any investor but particularly an investor like us long-term investor the longer that concentration persists the more you're tied up into that momentum
segments.zh: 市场集中度对任何投资者，尤其是长期投资者，集中度持续越久，越容易被动量捆绑

segments.en: and the more you worry of course that that concentration is vulnerable but we're now we're seeing a broadening out hopefully that continues that will reassure investors
segments.zh: 越担心集中度脆弱，但现在我们看到拓宽，希望持续，这将安抚投资者

segments.en: so as a result we're still overweight risk assets but you said look beyond just the semiconductor trade now absolutely
segments.zh: 因此我们仍超配风险资产，但你说要超越半导体交易，绝对如此

segments.en: absolutely and and beyond the US I think is that mostly in Asia then that so Asia offers some opportunities
segments.zh: 绝对，而且超越美国，主要在亚洲，亚洲提供一些机会

segments.en: we've seen a re-weighting if you look at the fund data out in this part of the world you've seen a re-weighting out of Taiwan out of Korea into other markets in the region
segments.zh: 我们看到资金重新配置，从台湾和韩国转向区域内其他市场

segments.en: not India yet but certainly we've seen a marginal increase in allocation to China I think Taiwan and Korea obviously very much tied to the AI theme
segments.zh: 印度尚未，但对中国市场的配置略有增加，台湾和韩国显然与AI主题紧密相关

segments.en: so all of those comments about concentration have spilled over into those markets and that's why we're seeing a broadening out if you like in this part of the world as well
segments.zh: 关于集中度的评论也影响了这些市场，因此我们看到区域市场也在拓宽

segments.en: yeah I mean to your point you could argue Korea and Taiwan are still in that concentration phase that the US is getting out of right now
segments.zh: 你说得对，韩国和台湾可能仍处于美国正在摆脱的集中度阶段

segments.en: so when you look at China then for example and some of that is spilling over into greater Chinese markets so what where is the value is that a hedge is that so I play how are you looking at that
segments.zh: 那么看中国，部分资金流入大中华市场，价值在哪里？是对冲还是其他？你怎么看？

segments.en: yeah so valuations between Hong Kong and China are pretty much within the normal range now so the allocation between the two international investors are sort of looking at that and adding incrementally
segments.zh: 香港和中国市场的估值已处于正常区间，国际投资者正在考虑并逐步增加配置

segments.en: I think to China obviously it's a two-speed economy where you've got you know what two engines you've got the export sector and you've got the tech sector
segments.zh: 中国是双速经济，有出口和科技两大引擎

segments.en: which is really driving growth in China Hong Kong of course the market is exposed to global themes so as rates rise that obviously puts a little bit of pressure on Hong Kong valuations
segments.zh: 这推动中国增长，香港市场则受全球主题影响，利率上升对香港估值构成压力

segments.en: in the way that we've just discussed but overall I think China stands to benefit more from the incremental allocation because that AI theme is slightly different slightly more nascent
segments.zh: 但总体而言，中国更能从增量配置中受益，因为AI主题略有不同，更为初期

segments.en: and of course the IPO pipeline here is still very very strong as we've seen in Hong Kong and that is dominated of course by by what we're seeing coming out of China
segments.zh: 而且这里的IPO管道依然非常强劲，正如我们在香港所见，主要来自中国的新发行

segments.en: in terms of new issuance particularly in technology
segments.zh: 尤其是科技领域的新发行
